allowlist.construction: Explicit union of 552 individually inspected INCLUDE decisions and eight separately inspected checkpoint artifacts. Not a blanket git status list.

manifest_binding: The manifest is the only allowlisted file without a self-hash; its SHA-256 must be supplied separately from the researcher-facing handoff. All other 559 allowlisted files, including the allowlist, are bound here.

inspection.method: Whole-file reading/scanning and structured parsing for every proposed inclusion, plus contextual source/seed/linkage review. Excluded protected/token/temp material was not universally opened; exclusions were conservative. Regex scans are not a universal secret guarantee.

limitations: Eight key-bearing source helpers/controllers are omitted; 18 test files depend on them.
Private corpus, prompts, manifests, raw outputs, review protocols, model weights and vendor runtimes remain necessary for complete controlled-access reproduction.
Historical ledger/unstarted test assumptions fail against later completed studies; tests and evidence were preserved.
The existing base Git history was not purged or comprehensively audited; no guarantee of an entirely clean historical repository.

required_cautions: Current RPC delivery instructions contain a key-equivalent seeded construction; do not distribute further before separately versioned correction and truthful exposure assessment.
Original development log remains local; its labeled redacted derivative carries the current public narrative without rewriting original evidence.
Scheduler installer must receive an explicit action switch; no-argument dispatch can install.
This checkpoint is appropriate for an informed manual archival commit, not a claim of complete reproducibility, green CI, clean blinded review, or publication readiness.
